notes: scan044.N1. The page continues with des espaces stratifiés and has no authorial number at the top. Twenty-two main baselines, one complete small interlinear insertion, the replacement tels, the cancelled phrase cela devrait, and pale foliation 43 were read. There is no independent drawing or diagram. The two paragraphs and the physical d’in-/dices and half-/simpliciales line breaks are preserved.

scan044.N2. The six opening or closing quotation marks at the three quoted expressions are high paired strokes, not French guillemets. Each physical mark has its own change row. H’s section heading beginning 2. Stratifications globales does not occur on this sheet and is excluded as editorial or out-of-page material, without inferring where it belongs.

scan044.N3. The cancellation at line 3 crosses cela devrait only. The above-line tels remains live and replaces the whole cancelled phrase after the formula comma. The small line et voisinages tubulaires parmi ceux-ci attaches after sous-espaces and before qu’on. No independent leader or terminal comma is visible. The dense strokes of groupoïdes are retraced letters, not a cancellation.

scan044.N4. M0966 resolves to parmi ceux-ci and M0967 to nébuleusement. Their C spellings stand; clearing the certainty wrappers alone does not count as a C correction. H’s associer uncertainty is also readable without a lexical change. Teichmüller has visible paired umlaut dots over the u; both witnesses agree on the word.

scan044.N5. Three uncertainties remain explicit. In K(pi,1), the bent right leg favors lowercase pi, while the tall strokes admit capital Pi. In les/leurs before sous-espaces, the low retraced humps do not distinguish the words. In desdites/des dites, the des/di gap is comparable to an internal di/t pen lift and much smaller than the space before pièces, favoring the joined form; spacing alone does not exclude H’s separate words. None of these additions of certainty markup is counted as a substantive correction. These two open lexical/spacing disputes are also retained in the H comparison table as tentative disagreements with the primary reading; neither is counted against C.

scan044.N6. The source spells standart and writes the final locution là dessus without a hyphen. In the latter place, a long descender from plus above and a brown speck below must not be recast as punctuation. The word relatives ends with a detached curved s, explaining H’s apparent extra comma. The contraction à has a curved lower stroke plus accent and can look like a colon, at both grâce à and souvent à.

scan044.N7. A limited mathematical check distinguishes an ordinary colimit of groupoids from a construction recovering a total homotopy type. Every connected groupoid is equivalent to a one-object group, so its classifying space is a K(G,1); a disjoint union still has no higher homotopy groups. Therefore an ordinary colimit taken within groupoids, followed by its classifying space, cannot by itself recover a space with nonzero higher homotopy. This does not refute the author’s qualified système inductif convenable: the written half-simplicial techniques can supply realization or gluing data beyond a bare groupoid colimit. The limitation is diagnostic and no source text is corrected by it. More explicitly, for a discrete group G the translation groupoid on its elements has a unique arrow between any two objects, so its nerve is contractible; its free G quotient is BG. Thus the higher homotopy groups of BG vanish. This supplies the local reason used in the diagnostic check.

scan044.N8. The recovery claim for suitably stratified spaces and the asserted relevance to Teichmüller moduli spaces are carried as the author’s proposed framework. This page promises later precision and further work; it does not give the indexing system, maps, compatibility data, or a proof of the claim. No general reconstruction theorem or claim of triviality is certified here.

scan044.N9. The crop b19 was extended downward before its final reading because its first boundary clipped the lowest simpliciales descender. That repair did not introduce a second independent place. The newly noticed hyphen question in the last line received its own tight b22. All 22 retained crops were visually inspected, and no OCR, external research, or other page was consulted.

scan044.N10. The main reader compared the next sheet and located the section heading there, on scan045. Its appended position in the supplied H text of scan044 is recorded as a page-placement error; no heading is inserted on scan044.

scan044.N11: Blind adjudication prefers pierres with pièces retained as alternative at the first quoted noun, and reopens the cancelled cela devrait without inventing an alternative from the crossing. The final punctuation is a dash, not the point both witnesses supplied. The separate hyphen after the half sign and the detached s of relatives remain. This note supersedes the former count of three uncertainties in N5.

scan044.N12. A final cross-page comparison also reopens the second noun after desdites: its two angular low shoulders match the first quoted occurrence and the clearer rr forms on scan058. Both now prefer pierres with pièces as alternative. First and blind readers had agreed on pièces at this second occurrence; that agreement did not settle it. This later notation correction is separate from the completed blind-audit count.
